_doc: Single source of truth for dialogue speaker -> TTS voice routing (inv 23). Imported by DialogueListenStepView.tsx (runtime playback) and read by scripts/emit-tts-deck.mjs (clip generation). These two used to be hand-copied twins holding only the romanized names, so every kana-labelled male speaker in m8-m10 silently played the female Nanami voice. dialogueSpeakerRegistry.test.ts fails the build on any speaker label that appears in the course but not here, so a new name cannot default-to-female by omission.
